notes: DiscoFlate v3.52.0 — 🎬 GO LIVE OPTIONS: flipping LIVE on can open with an intro instead of starting the game. A scene group plays, an announcement posts (with an optional image, and repeating if you want), and COMMANDS STAY HELD the whole time so nobody can play during your pre-show — with an allow-list for the ones that should work anyway. Set a length or leave it open-ended and end it with the new 🎬 Start now button in Chat. [intro_timer] counts down in messages AND overlays. TEXT OVERLAYS are now multi-line with left/centre/right alignment, and their placeholders KEEP UPDATING while on screen — so a countdown or a score ticks live without re-firing. STAGES ARE NOW SCENES (matching OBS; config migrates itself), scene groups are scoped to their own scene so two scenes can both have an 'intro', and exporting a scene bundles every image and video it uses into one .dfscene.zip. New [timer:<device>] placeholder gives any device's own countdown while [timer] still means the primary pump. Plus the Chat tab's buttons moved into a panel beside the log.
